# Venband

Venband is an open source, end-to-end encrypted chat, voice and video platform. Website: https://www.venband.com

## Core features
- End-to-end encrypted text chat (AES-256-GCM, client-side keys; server cannot read messages)
- Servers (communities) with channels: text, voice, stage, forum, announcement
- Roles and granular permissions (manage server, channels, members, messages, etc.)
- Direct messages and group chats
- Voice and video calls with screen sharing, peer-to-peer (DTLS-SRTP), end-to-end encrypted
- Server discovery and public listings
- Invites with expiry, max uses, account-age requirements
- Reactions, replies, edits, deletes, pins, threads/forums
- File attachments (encrypted client-side)
- Emoji, stickers, GIF search (Klipy), soundboard
- Markdown rendering, code blocks, link previews
- Presence, typing indicators, read receipts (where enabled)
- Notifications and unread tracking

## Security and privacy
- End-to-end encryption for messages, files, voice and video
- Password-derived keys (Argon2id + HKDF); server never sees password
- Private keys encrypted with vault key before storage
- Channel key rotation on membership changes
- Row-level security on all tables
- No ads, no third-party trackers, no data selling
- IP addresses are never shown; only a peppered hash at signup for rate limiting
- Voogle verification: one-way hashes for anti-alt/raid protection, never readable
- Account deletion and data export from Settings
- Open source under MIT license

## Accounts and identity
- Email/password signup with email verification
- MFA (TOTP) and recovery codes
- Passkey support
- Device sessions with rough location
- Profile: display name, avatar, bio, status, pronouns, banner, nameplate
- Badges and platform roles (owner, admin, moderator)
- Account status levels (active, limited, very limited, banned)

## Connections (linked accounts)
- Steam (OpenID)
- Spotify (OAuth PKCE)
- YouTube (Google OAuth)
- TikTok (OAuth)
- Twitch, Discord, GitHub, Xbox, Instagram, Epic (planned or in progress)

## Bots and developers
- Bot accounts with tokens
- Application commands and templates
- Bot directory / app discovery
- Webhooks
- API for bots
- Voogle verification API for servers

## Moderation and safety
- Reports and moderation queue
- Timeouts, warnings, kicks, bans
- Automod filters
- Content guidelines and terms enforcement
- Appeal flow

## Apps and extras
- Voogle (anti-alt verification)
- Storage console (Vercel Blob, staff only)
- Themes and custom CSS
- Activities and games (e.g. Wordle preset)
- Polls
- Marketplace
- Downloadable desktop (Electron) and Android apps
- Status page
